intent.deliverable: A reviewed intent brief and validated intent record with the requested result, workload, target constraints and open decisions.
intent.evidence: Schema checks and a review record trace each accepted requirement to the original request, a verified fact or a reviewed clarification.

contract.deliverable: A versioned engine contract for the Workflow orchestrator, derived from the reviewed brief and system ontology, with tensor and token conventions, memory envelope, frozen workloads and acceptance thresholds. Open checkpoint fields and conflicting obligations remain explicit.
contract.evidence: Check the obligations against the approved brief and identified model and target facts. Reproduce a verdict from the stated workload, units and thresholds.

plan.deliverable: Agent assignments and scoped work orders that name the component builder, contract revision, versioned interfaces, fixture seeds and suppliers for the checkpoint, tokenizer, configuration, independent reference and target profile.
plan.evidence: Trace each interface and required input to a reachable producer or an identified external supplier. Check reuse against the applicable configuration and verification record.

weights.deliverable: A checkpoint reader implementation and validated tensor directory with revisioned model, configuration and tokenizer bindings, shard offsets, expert ranges, shapes and stored formats.
weights.evidence: Check required tensor names and ranges against the mounted checkpoint, verify a sample expert block hash, and show rejection of a missing shard or truncated range.

serving.deliverable: Gateway, token codec, scheduler and batch layout code with a stub forward call and a versioned image interface manifest for completion, model mounts, readiness and diagnostics.
serving.evidence: Replay the pinned tokenizer transcript and verify prompt IDs, special tokens, row positions, incremental text, stop events and cancellation cleanup.

reference.deliverable: A callable small reference decoder with embedding, decoder, dense attention and vocabulary projection code, plus a callable boundary for swapping in the routed block.
reference.evidence: Compare embedding and attention rows and logits with independent expected values, including nonzero positions and a cached token step checked against full-prefix recomputation. Record the reference identity, weights, input IDs and tolerances.

routing.deliverable: A callable router, expert feed-forward block and row dispatcher and combiner with an interface for exact weight demand and a mapping back to token order.
routing.evidence: Check selected IDs, mixture weights and restored rows against an independent oracle across ties, repeated expert picks and a nontrivial row permutation.

state.deliverable: Sequence KV cache and workspace allocator code exposing append, read and release operations, buffer handles, allocation lifetimes and last-use completion rules.
state.evidence: Exercise cancellation, reuse under pressure and delayed completion. Compare measured live and temporary bytes with the size model at supported shapes.

placement.deliverable: A weight placement planner and its placement manifest and byte ledger, covering resident weights, live KV, scratch, slots, staging, transient unpacking and headroom.
placement.evidence: Check the largest expert demand and temporary allocation against the unified memory ceiling, count shared physical pages once, and show that an infeasible shape is rejected.

storage.deliverable: An expert weight cache implementation with exact-demand lookup, deduplicated asynchronous fills, ready handles and last-reader release.
storage.evidence: Replay cold misses, eviction, duplicate requests, short reads and delayed completion. Match consumed handles to the expected range and byte hash, compare against resident execution, and report peak bytes and exposed wait.

kernels.deliverable: Kernel dispatcher and weight block decoder code, plus a dispatch table and dependency manifest pinning implementations, supported shapes, pack formats, device prerequisites and stream and buffer requirements.
kernels.evidence: Compare decoded blocks and operator results separately against independent references in prefill and decode. Record peak temporary bytes and verify the forced fallback or unsupported-input outcome.

assemble.deliverable: A reviewed source revision with the generation loop and sampler wired to request serving, decoder, state, storage and kernels, plus a reproducible build request with pinned dependencies.
assemble.evidence: Replay prefill and repeated decode, check intermediate rows, logits and committed IDs against an independent reference, and record forced-cold reads, peak bytes, response and cleanup. Mark any gate without the required pack, target or reference as open.

image.deliverable: A runnable engine image and collected build receipt with immutable image and archive digests, pinned source and dependencies, launch configuration and separately mounted checkpoint and tokenizer identities.
image.evidence: Record build logs, clean-start library, device and pack checks, and an external transcript covering readiness, deterministic completion, repeated decode, stop and the enabled diagnostics.

qualify.deliverable: A reproducible trial receipt and scoped pass, fail or inconclusive verdict tied to the exact image, model pack, target, workload and contract revision.
qualify.evidence: Report held-out quality, cold and warm first-token and decode latency, exposed storage waits, peak unified memory, uncertainty and exclusions against the frozen baseline and thresholds.

route_trace.deliverable: Runtime event recorder code and a versioned event schema correlating route selection, exact demand, transfer completion and first use.
route_trace.evidence: Replay a trace against known token and expert order and fill identities. Compare instrumentation enabled and disabled under the same workload to bound overhead.

forecast.deliverable: An opt-in expert demand predictor wired to the existing cache as a source of advisory prefetch hints.
forecast.evidence: Inject wrong hints and confirm parity with exact demand. On held-out workloads compare useful and unused bytes, exposed wait and token latency, and report whether the gains and quality meet the gates.

capture.deliverable: An execution graph backend with capture keys, replay, stale-address invalidation and an eager fallback through the existing dispatcher.
capture.evidence: Check parity across captures, hits, shape transitions and fallback. Compare matched warm decode shapes and report capture overhead and peak memory separately.

prefix_reuse.deliverable: A prefix state cache and a sequence KV cache change to share compatible pages with explicit lifetime and invalidation rules.
prefix_reuse.evidence: Compare cached continuation logits against fresh prefill across partial-page branches, concurrent siblings, eviction and adapter mismatch. Measure saved prefill work and retained bytes.

pack_convert.deliverable: A checksummed target weight pack and its conversion manifest, produced using the existing weight pack compiler and block decoder.
pack_convert.evidence: For lossless conversion, verify decoded blocks, tensor equivalence, tails and scale order. For precision changes, report numerical error against the source and qualify model-level effects against the contract.

dense_path.deliverable: A callable dense feed-forward implementation and decoder stack changes that select it at the checkpoint's declared layer indices.
dense_path.evidence: Compare intermediate and final values against an independent dense reference for ragged prompts and single-token decode.
